name: 회풍 · 저승길 차림
face: 날카롭고 매끄러운 턱선, 눈매가 긴 도깨비 형상
wings: 얇고 빛나는 네 개의 날개 조각
outfit: 올리브색 쾌자 스타일의 암살복과 헝겊 띠
shoes: 발목을 감싸는 짚신 형태의 가죽 장화
special_item: 공중에 떠 있는 신성한 기류 구슬
silhouette: 사마귀의 거대한 낫 형태 무기, 등 뒤에 흩날리는 4개의 날개 파편, 머리 위의 빛나는 후광, 길고 가느다란 꼬리
signature_motion: 바람처럼 빠르게 회전하며 주변의 적을 베어 넘기는 동작
signature_vfx: 에메랄드빛 소용돌이가 휘감기는 강한 바람의 칼날
visual_en: A small 40px character featuring a divine golden halo floating above a head with emerald glowing compound eyes. The body is covered in dark khaki chitinous skin and olive-colored fur. Four separate, glowing emerald wing fragments drift behind the back. A slender, insectoid tail extends downwards. The character wears a dark olive traditional Korean assassin's vest with gold-trimmed edges. A floating magical orb of swirling wind orbits the waist. The character holds a large, translucent scythe that glimmers with light.
features_en: Underworld Road outfit: an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality
pose_en: Standing in a low, predatory crouch, ready to spring forward.
vfx_en: Swirling emerald-colored wind blades and gusts.

derive.prompt: Keep this exact same character: the same face, head, hair, body shape, size, pose and skin, and the same hands holding the same weapon in the same place. Change only the clothing and accessories to an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality. Keep the body colors readable on both dark stone and light grey floors (not all black, not all white). Full body, three-quarter view facing right.
